Our mission is to promote tourism and in turn help local communities by providing employment. We had a great trip to the Spiti Valley with Spiti Valley Tours. They setup the hotels, breakfast/dinner and treks.  They were responsive and communicated ok.

We has an experienced driver (Sanjeev).  He has a nice car and drove us the complete route.  It is a long route.  7 plus days.  We were scheduled to do 10 days but my daughter and wife did get impacted by the high elevation 15,000 ft above Kaza.  We ended up not doing the trek.  It was very high but hot.  There are roads which reach 1 of the 2 treks.  I would have trekked lower down where there were some trees.  Scenery is prettier.  Again, it is a lot of driving.  We were traveling at the start of the rainy season.  Some road issues too.

Looking back, I would have reviewed some of the hotels better.  Accommodations are limited and basic in the spiti valley.  We were not impressed with Manali after being in the spiti valley.  In all should plan maybe different hikes.  However, it was quite hot when we went.  Limited our options.

In all a good group but review your treks and housing and adjust as you see fit.

Dear Richard,

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience, and for choosing Spiti Valley Tours for your Himalayan journey.

We’re glad to hear you enjoyed the overall trip, including the scenic route and the support from our team and driver Sanjeev, who is indeed one of our most experienced partners.

Regarding accommodations, we’d like to clarify that your initial enquiry through our website specifically requested standard category stays, which is why we shared options accordingly. Deluxe upgrades were available and could have been provided had we known your preference at the time. In Spiti, especially in remote areas, infrastructure is still developing, and standard stays are basic yet clean and comfortable.

As for the trekking, we understand your concerns. Trekking options in Spiti are naturally limited due to the high-altitude terrain, and weather conditions can further narrow the possibilities. We always aim to customize routes based on guest preferences and physical comfort, especially when traveling with family.

Your insights are valuable and will help future travelers plan more effectively. We hope to have the opportunity to serve you again with a more tailored and seasonally optimized experience.

Team,
